window: Editorial assessment 17 Nov 08:48–18 Nov 08:48 America/Chicago. Ukraine Air Force overnight 17 Nov evening–18 Nov 08:00 Kyiv; Russian MoD overnight 17–18 Nov, exact start/end not verified. These are separate assessment windows, not synchronized 24-hour totals.
reporting_side: Ukraine Air Force official claims relayed by Ukrinform/Kyiv Independent; Russian Defense Ministry official claim relayed by Anadolu Agency; regional civilian impacts attributed to officials, with Reuters independent reporting of the occurrence of Odesa attacks.
notes: PRELIMINARY/ATTRIBUTED, NOT SYNCHRONIZED. Ukrainian Air Force reports 141 Russian long-range attack drones overnight (73 jet-powered), 126 neutralized (59 jet-powered), and impacts at seven locations as of 08:00 Kyiv. Russian MoD claims 184 Ukrainian drones intercepted overnight according to Anadolu; a separate secondary aggregator reports 183, so Russian tally is disputed and not independently corroborated. Ukraine-wide civilian deaths/injuries reported by regional authorities (5 killed, 15 injured in Kyiv Independent morning roundup) must not be added to later Odesa updates; Reuters separately reports four killed and at least seven injured in Odesa's subsequent morning strikes. Ukrainian energy ministry reports outages in eight oblasts. No independently verified aircraft losses. No verified live airspace status. The Ukrainian General Staff's daily 2 missile strikes/87 airstrikes/6990 tactical drones are a DIFFERENT operational category and must not be added to the overnight long-range drone count. Exact original primary-post times unavailable; article times retained when known.
